description_en: Queries the information about a migration task
description_zh: 调用GetMigrationSummary，获取导入导出任务的信息

parameters.description_en:
The migration task ID.

You can call the [CreateImportMigration](~~2780280~~) operation to obtain the ID of the import task and call the [CreateExportMigration](~~2780281~~) operation to obtain the ID of the export task.
parameters.description_zh:
